subject: Post-call: Redwood inference \u0014 procurement & billing next steps
raw_messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmeretail.com>, Tom Adler <t.adler@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood inference  procurement & billing next steps

Hi Samantha / Tom 

Thanks again for taking time today  good conversation and excited about the potential fit. Quick recap and the follow-ups I mentioned on the call: 

- Procurement path: you mentioned Acme prefers a PO-based process. Can you confirm if that will be an ACME-issued PO or if procurement expects a Redwood invoice first? Also confirm whether credit checks or vendor onboarding forms are required.
- Billing ops / invoice format: please confirm required invoice fields (PO number placement, remit-to address, line-item breakdown). Any specific PDF template you need is helpful.
- Net terms & payment method: is Net30 acceptable? Do you pay via ACH/Check/Virtual Card?
- Tax / VAT: confirm billing tax requirements (US vendor? VAT ID).
- Marketplace: you mentioned interest in listing on Acme marketplace  is that something procurement coordinates or a separate partner team?

Next steps from Redwood:
- I can send a sample invoice and a short order form for signature (DocuSign) once we confirm PO vs card.
- If you can share your PO template or onboarding packet, that will speed things up.

Would appreciate confirmation of the above and the correct billing contact (if different than Tom).

Thanks,


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

------------------------------

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Adler <t.adler@acmeretail.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood inference  procurement & billing next steps

Marissa 

Thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement: 

- PO process: yes, Acme prefers an ACME-issued PO. We generally require a completed vendor onboarding packet + W-9 before issuing POs for new vendors. Once onboarding is complete, procurement will issue the PO referencing the vendor invoice.
- Net terms: standard is Net30 for new vendors over the $50k threshold; if this is a smaller initial engagement we can do card/payments via virtual card.
- Invoice format: we need a PDF invoice that includes our PO number (when issued), your vendor name and EIN, line-item descriptions, and remit-to address.
- Tax: Acme is US-based; VAT does not apply. We will need your EIN on the invoice.

Ive looped in Tom from Billing Ops  Tom, can you send the PO template and any vendor onboarding docs to Marissa? Also, please confirm billing address and the email you want invoices sent to.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Green
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Retail Ltd
samantha.green@acmeretail.com

------------------------------

From: Tom Adler <t.adler@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmeretail.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood inference  procurement & billing next steps
Attachments: Acme_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf), Vendor_Onboarding_Form.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Hi Marissa 

Attaching our standard PO template and the vendor onboarding form. A few items to note: 

- Billing address: Acme Retail Ltd
  Attn: Accounts Payable
  200 Market Street
  Suite 100
  San Francisco, CA 94105

- Invoice email: invoices@acmeretail.com (please cc procurement@acmeretail.com on the first invoice)
- Tax/EIN: Our AP team requires your company EIN on invoices  please include Redwood Inference EIN: 12-3456789 (if you invoice under a parent/legal name, note that on the onboarding form)
- PO number: we will provide an ACME PO number after onboarding is complete; please include a 'PO Number' field on your invoice PDF so we can map it.
- Net terms: standard Net30 after receipt of a correct invoice. If you need earlier payment we can discuss virtual card for the pilot.

Vendor onboarding form includes our bank/ACH setup and W-9 upload instructions. Once you return the completed form I can expedite PO issuance.

Link to our vendor portal (for uploads & status): https://vendor.acmeretail.com/onboarding/portal/ACME-portal-id

Thanks 
Tom
Tom Adler
Billing Operations Manager, Acme Retail Ltd
t.adler@acmeretail.com

------------------------------

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Adler <t.adler@acmeretail.com>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood inference  procurement & billing next steps

Tom / Samantha 

Appreciate the fast follow-up and the attachments. Ive downloaded the PO template and onboarding form and will get those to our finance team today. Next steps from our side: 

1) Ill return the completed onboarding form and W-9 via your vendor portal by EOD tomorrow.
2) Once you confirm the PO issuance timeline well send an initial invoice in the requested PDF format and include the PO number when provided.
3) Logan (cc'd) will prepare a one-page order form for signature (DocuSign link) so we can capture the initial scope and expected start date while the onboarding completes.

If net30 is standard that works for us  well flag the account for priority processing to avoid delays. If you prefer virtual card for the pilot, let me know and we can route accordingly.

Thanks again  Ill follow up once onboarding is submitted.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

[Attachments referenced above]
